- Build a complete, playable 2D football career game centered on penalty kicks, with squad management and transfer features.

## Requirements
- 2D penalty-kick gameplay with realistic FIFA-style aiming and shot controls.
- Career mode supporting player signing, selling, and loans.
- Responsive mobile and desktop presentation.

- Built as a self-contained single-page HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.
- Used a dark match-day visual style with Matchday, Squad, and Transfer Hub views.

## Objective
- Complete a playable 2D football career game focused on penalty kicks, with squad management and transfers.
- Keep the game responsive on desktop and mobile.

## Requirements
- FIFA-style aiming and shot controls.
- Career actions for signing, selling, and loaning players.
- Responsive desktop and mobile presentation.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained single-page HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.
- Keep the existing dark match-day design and Matchday, Squad, and Transfer Hub views.

- Completed penalty gameplay controls, shot/keeper animation, score progression, opponent kicks, sudden death, restart, and power adjustment.
- Finished squad and transfer interactions, including filters, search, signings, loans, sales, confirmations, and budget updates.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check`, passed `git diff --check`, and captured desktop and mobile screenshots in Chromium.

### Active
- Further functional verification of in-browser gameplay and career interactions.

- (none)

1. Test gameplay and transfer/squad interactions in a browser, including restart during the opponent-kick delay and sudden death.
2. Fix any issues found and recheck responsive behavior.

- `index.html`: Complete single-file game implementation.

- `index.html` is untracked and changes are uncommitted.
- Screenshots were saved to `/tmp/opencode/touchline-desktop.png` and `/tmp/opencode/touchline-mobile.png`; browser launches emitted D-Bus warnings but produced screenshots.

## Objective
- Complete a playable 2D football career game focused on penalty kicks, with squad management and transfers.
- Keep the game responsive on desktop and mobile.

## Requirements
- FIFA-style aiming and shot controls.
- Career actions for signing, selling, and loaning players.
- Responsive desktop and mobile presentation.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained single-page HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.
- Keep the existing dark match-day design and Matchday, Squad, and Transfer Hub views.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented penalty gameplay, scoring, opponent kicks, restart, power adjustment, squad management, and transfer interactions.
- Verified JavaScript syntax; screenshots were previously captured at desktop and mobile sizes.

### Active
- Browser-test gameplay and career interactions; fix issues uncovered.

- (none)

1. Rerun browser tests after the latest gameplay fixes.
2. Verify repeated kicks, restart during the opponent-kick delay, and sudden-death progression.
3. Recheck signing, loaning, sale cancellation, touch controls, and mobile overflow.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; recent gameplay fixes are unverified.

- `index.html` is untracked and changes are uncommitted.
